scheme_name: Fellowship for the Post-Graduate Students in Various Faculties Various Faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University
description:
The Fellowship for the Post-Graduate Students in Various Faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University is a government initiative aimed at supporting postgraduate students in their academic pursuits.

This scheme was launched in the year 2017 to promote higher education in agriculture and allied sectors.

The primary objective of this fellowship is to encourage students to pursue advanced studies and research in agricultural sciences.

The fellowship aims to enhance the quality of education and research output from the university.

The specific goals include increasing the number of postgraduate students in agricultural disciplines by 20 percent over five years.

The fellowship provides financial assistance to eligible students to help cover their educational expenses.

The amount of the fellowship is set at INR 5,000 per month for each eligible postgraduate student.

This financial support is provided for a maximum duration of two years.

The total financial assistance for each student can thus amount to INR 120,000 over the fellowship period.

Eligibility for the fellowship includes being a full-time postgraduate student enrolled in any of the faculties at Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University.

Students must have completed their undergraduate degree in agriculture or related fields from a recognized institution.

The age limit for applicants is set at a maximum of 30 years at the time of application.

Candidates must also demonstrate a minimum of 55 percent marks in their undergraduate degree to qualify for the fellowship.

The application process requires students to fill out a specific application form available on the university's official website.

Applicants must submit a copy of their admission letter to the postgraduate program.

Additionally, students need to provide proof of their undergraduate degree and academic performance.

A recommendation letter from a faculty member is also required as part of the application.

The completed application form along with all necessary documents must be submitted to the university's fellowship committee.

The deadline for submission of applications is typically set at the end of August each year.

The university announces the selected candidates by mid-September.

Disbursement of the fellowship amount occurs on a monthly basis starting from the month of selection.

The funds are directly credited to the bank accounts of the selected students.

The implementing authority for this fellowship is the Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University.

The university is located in the Banaskantha district of Gujarat.

For any inquiries regarding the fellowship, students can contact the university's administrative office.

The contact number for the university is +91 2741 248 100.

The official website of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University is www.sdau.edu.in.

This fellowship is part of a broader initiative by the Government of India to enhance research and education in agriculture.

The scheme aligns with the National Agricultural Policy which emphasizes the importance of higher education in agriculture.

The fellowship not only supports students financially but also aims to foster innovation in agricultural practices.

It encourages students to engage in research projects that can lead to sustainable agricultural practices.

The university has reported an increase in enrollment in postgraduate programs since the introduction of this fellowship.

Statistically, there has been a 15 percent increase in postgraduate admissions in the agricultural faculties since 2017.

The fellowship has also contributed to improved research output from the university.

Students who have received the fellowship have published numerous research papers in national and international journals.

The university conducts regular workshops and seminars to enhance the research capabilities of fellowship recipients.

These workshops cover various topics including modern agricultural techniques and research methodologies.

The fellowship program is reviewed annually to assess its impact and effectiveness.

Feedback from students is collected to improve the program and address any challenges faced by recipients.

The university aims to expand the fellowship program to include more disciplines in the future.

The fellowship is part of the university's commitment to contributing to the agricultural sector's development in India.

It plays a crucial role in building a skilled workforce capable of addressing the challenges in agriculture.

The fellowship also promotes collaboration between students and faculty members on research projects.

This collaboration enhances the learning experience and provides practical exposure to students.

The university has established partnerships with various agricultural research institutions to further support fellowship recipients.

These partnerships provide additional resources and opportunities for research and development.

The fellowship is a significant step towards achieving the goal of food security in India.

By investing in education and research, the government aims to improve agricultural productivity.

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to empowering the youth in the agricultural sector.

It also aligns with the Sustainable Development Goals set by the United Nations.

The fellowship encourages students to contribute to innovative solutions for agricultural challenges.

Overall, the Fellowship for the Post-Graduate Students in Various Faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University is a vital initiative.

It provides essential financial support to students pursuing higher education in agriculture.

The scheme not only benefits individual students but also contributes to the overall development of the agricultural sector in India.
